{
  "dataset_name": "anon_dataset_03",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gpt-5.5-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "x001_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Range-normalized x001 on the observed 0 to 3 ordinal scale.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "range_normalized_ordinal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Places x001 on a common 0-1 scale so the linear SVM can use a stable margin coefficient.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "x001 / 3.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "x002_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Range-normalized x002 on the observed 0 to 3 ordinal scale.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "range_normalized_ordinal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Places x002 on a common 0-1 scale so the linear SVM can use a stable margin coefficient.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "x002 / 3.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "x003_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Range-normalized x003 on the observed 0 to 3 ordinal scale.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "range_normalized_ordinal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Keeps the four-level x003 signal numerically comparable with the other ordinal inputs.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "x003 / 3.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "x004_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Range-normalized x004 on the observed 0 to 2 ordinal scale.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "range_normalized_ordinal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Gives the linear SVM a calibrated single-column severity coordinate for x004.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "x004 / 2.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "x005_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Range-normalized x005 on the observed 0 to 2 ordinal scale.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "range_normalized_ordinal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Gives the linear SVM a calibrated single-column severity coordinate for x005.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "x005 / 2.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "x006_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Range-normalized x006 on the observed 0 to 2 ordinal scale.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "range_normalized_ordinal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Gives the linear SVM a calibrated single-column severity coordinate for x006.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "x006 / 2.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "leading_pair_load_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average magnitude of the first two four-level ordinal columns after range scaling.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "weighted_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a compact projection of the leading-pair burden pattern, which can improve regularized margin stability.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(x001 + x002) / 6.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "core_support_interaction_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Multiplicative joint score for x004 and x006 after scaling both to 0-1.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a smooth synergy coordinate that a purely linear use of the raw ordinal columns would not express directly.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(x004 / 2.0) * (x006 / 2.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "core_minimum_level_count_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized count of minimum-level observations among x004 and x006.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "low_end_severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Exposes gate-like low-end patterns as a simple severity measure for the linear SVM margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(x004 == 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(x006 == 0, 1.0, 0.0)) / 2.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "support_to_load_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Smoothed ratio of the range-scaled later-column support sum to the range-scaled leading-pair load sum.",
      "value_range": [
        0.3333333333,
        5.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures trade-off structure in one numeric coordinate, helping linear margins represent relative rather than only additive effects.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(1.0 + (x003 / 3.0) + (x004 / 2.0) + (x005 / 2.0) + (x006 / 2.0)) / (1.0 + (x001 / 3.0) + (x002 / 3.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "semantic_balance_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Ordinal semantic assessment of whether the six-coordinate profile is well-rounded; 0.0 means highly uneven with strong bottlenecks, and 1.0 means balanced across the available ordinal dimensions.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_profile_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Supplies a holistic smooth signal for cases where several mild weaknesses combine, giving the linear SVM an additional margin input.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "semantic_tradeoff_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Ordinal semantic assessment of whether the last four coordinates provide enough support relative to the first two coordinates; 0.0 means poor trade-off, and 1.0 means strong trade-off. The score must be assigned from row values alone using the same rule for every row.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_tradeoff_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures broad support-versus-load evidence in one calibrated coordinate, helping the linear SVM use holistic trade-off patterns.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
